question: Shamshad begum, one of the first women to sing playback for Hindi movies, was conferred with the prestigious OP Nayyar Award for her contribution to Hindi film Music in the year _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2009**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Shamshad Begum born on **14 April 1919 – 23 April 2013 was an Indian singer who was one of the first playback singers in the Hindi film industry**.
 
• In **2009**, she was conferred with the prestigious **O. P. Nayyar Award for her contribution to Hindi film music**.
 
• She was also conferred the **Padma Bhushan in 2009.**
 
• She sang over **6,000 songs in Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, Gujarati, Tamil, and Punjabi languages, among which 1287 were Hindi film songs**.
 
• She worked with renowned composers of the time, such as** Naushad Ali and O. P. Nayyar.****​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• She started to become popular when she began singing on** All India Radio (AIR) in Peshawar and Lahore in 1937.**
 
• She sang four out of twelve songs in the first Indian Oscar-nominated movie **Mother India**.
 
• Her most famous songs are, L**eke Pehla Pehla Pyar, Kahin Pe Nigahen Kahin Pe Nishana, Boojh Mera Kya Naam Re, Kabhi Aar Kabhi Paar Laga Teer-e-Nazar.**
 
• Some of the popular movies in which she sang are **Daku Mangal Singh, Upkar, Kismat, Heer Ranjha, Johar Mehmood in Hong Kong, Teri Meri Ik Jindri, and Main Papi Tum Bakhshanhaar.**
